description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting +1/+1 counter(s) on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting +1/+1 counter(s) on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting +1/+1 counter(s) on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 5
